question: Can an independently implemented amplitude-matched saturating donor extend the existing bounded interimage-development primitive while preserving exact reference-point amplitude, the linear limit, density bounds, monotonic own-channel response, cross-suppression sign and symmetric neutral-axis invariance?
claim_ceiling: generic physical-inspired clean-room interimage donor primitive and synthetic known-operator evidence only; no measured chemistry, stock, process, scanner, calibrated response, external-output reproduction or product claim

research_basis.source: Shuto et al., Mechanism of the Interimage-Effect in Color Reversal System and Its Application to Improve Color Reproduction, IS&T 1997
research_basis.use: primary experimental evidence for imagewise inhibitor release and cross-layer colour-reproduction effects; no Langmuir parameter calibration
latest observed mechanism hypothesis and external BS0 comparison only; no source or profile copying

forbidden_fallbacks: copy external implementation text, source, profiles or LUTs into the project
use external rendered outputs as fitting targets or teacher truth
change donor fractions, witnesses, samples, seeds, gates or partitions after execution
fit any parameter on photographs or the sealed 71-pair display-proxy pool
call the result a measured DIR response, stock response, calibrated chemistry or product operator
advance to photographs if any automatic gate fails

branch_rule.pass: retain the clean-room primitive and open one fixed photographic value/safety comparison in the existing generic physical chain
branch_rule.fail: close the independent primitive without changing existing U2/U5/U6 champions
